metadata.description: Portable agent skills for Polish shopping research and 3D printing, plus anything else that lands here.

plugins.name: shopping-pl
plugins.description: Finds, filters and ranks purchase offers on Polish sites (Ceneo, OLX, Allegro Lokalnie, online shops) and returns a shortlist with verified links.

plugins.name: 3d-print
plugins.description: Designs parametric OpenSCAD models from a description, photo or measurements, and slices and prints them on an ELEGOO Centauri Carbon given its IP.
